title: Ambiguous POST completion
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Lose a committed POST response, retry with controlled key, payload, ledger and response assumptions, then distinguish exactly one correct business effect from duplicate effects or an explicitly unresolved client.
preconditions: A modern browser supporting local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
One fixed synthetic 10-unit order with synth-key-A; the first response is always lost after commit.
The atomic option assumes a single shared atomic key, payload and remembered-result ledger.
No account, credentials, subscription, server, framework, network request or actual transaction.
actions: Choose atomic or absent deduplication, retry key, retry payload, retry reply delivery and bounded original timing.
Commit one POST and lose its response; observe one effect and an unresolved client.
Retry once and inspect the synthetic effect ledger, client result, trace and original deadline.
Check a prediction separately from user impact and retain the complete attempt.
Start another attempt without dropping history, or explicitly reset all in-memory state.
input: learning/S049/model.js DEFAULT_CONFIG and fixed synthetic operation
assertions: The same key and payload replay the original result without another effect under the atomic-ledger assumption.
No deduplication or a changed key duplicates the business effect.
The same key with changed payload or a missing key is rejected without another commit.
Success requires exactly one effect and the correct client result within the inclusive original deadline.
Without a known failure, another lost response yields an explicit unresolved unknown result.
Known duplicate effects and budget breaches dominate uncertainty.
Invalid input and out-of-order commands do not change private state or retained history.
Keyboard controls, visible errors, exact reset and restrictive CSP work in an actual isolated browser.

history.eviction: none; a seventh attempt is blocked

iac.reason: Resource-free lesson; decision recorded after genuine loadable-stub assertion RED and before implementation.

testRuntime.purpose: existing test tooling only; not production Node.js 24 certification
testRuntime.browserLifecycle: openIsolatedLesson; awaited close in finally; known unattended lifecycle limitation remains unqualified

limits: All keys, payloads, effects, traces, HTTP-like responses and elapsed times are synthetic.
No real HTTP POST, server cutover, transaction atomicity, distributed retry safety, live Azure outcome or reliability guarantee is established.
No identity or authentication behavior is needed or simulated.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, registration, credentials, deployment, expenditure, downloads, frameworks, packages or shared source changes.
Normal verification does not write proof; browser evidence capture requires CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1.
B-S049 and original D-S049 native acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
One frozen S unit only; tests and evidence earn no extra credit. Parent alone accepts.
